title: Keen Eye
description: A bald eagle emerging from a dark background, sharp gaze, bright head against deep shadow. Bold, patriotic, and high contrast, this one commands a wall. A strong pick for an office, den, or anywhere you want a bit of intensity.
Printed on 230 gsm archival matte fine art paper. Rich blacks, no glare, built to last indoors for years. Ships flat and ready to frame. Free US shipping.

title: On Alert
description: A German shepherd in profile, mouth open, caught mid moment with loose energetic charcoal strokes. Full of motion and life rather than a stiff pose. A great fit for shepherd owners or anyone who likes an animal portrait with some fire in it.
Printed on 230 gsm archival matte fine art paper. Rich blacks, no glare, built to last indoors for years. Ships flat and ready to frame. Free US shipping.

title: Curled
description: A cat curled into a perfect circle, half asleep, softened at the edges. Cozy, simple, and charming. Charcoal’s soft smudging suits the fur and the sleepy mood. An easy favorite for cat people and a warm little piece for any room.
Printed on 230 gsm archival matte fine art paper. Rich blacks, no glare, built to last indoors for years. Ships flat and ready to frame. Free US shipping.

title: Steel and Glass
description: A classic still life in charcoal, a silver teapot and patterned bowl resting in a deep arched alcove. The pull between the near-black background and the bright metal highlights is what makes this one. A quiet, timeless piece that suits a study, dining room, or anywhere you want a bit of old world weight on the wall.
Printed on 230 gsm archival matte fine art paper. Rich blacks, no glare, built to last indoors for years. Ships flat and ready to frame. Free US shipping.

title: Through the Clouds
description: A lone peak breaking through drifting fog, drawn entirely in charcoal. Soft mist against sharp rock, deep valleys fading into white. A calm, dramatic landscape that works in almost any room and reads beautifully from across a space.
Printed on 230 gsm archival matte fine art paper. Rich blacks, no glare, built to last indoors for years. Ships flat and ready to frame. Free US shipping.
